channel.title: US Top News and Analysis
channel.description: CNBC is the world leader in business news and real-time financial market coverage. Find fast, actionable information.

item.title: Anthropic IPO takeaways: ANT debuts with $1.8 trillion market cap in landmark moment for AI
item.description: Anthropic IPO live updates: Follow ANT stock's Nasdaq debut, opening share price, valuation and investor reaction to the Claude AI maker.

item.title: AMD dives on short seller report of alleged China exposure
item.description: AMD closed down over 7% after a short seller alleged that its firmware showed up at a blacklisted Chinese company. AMD said it complies with U.S. law.

item.title: California attorney general issues Nvidia subpoena in probe of China chip diversion
item.description: The investigation by California Attorney General Rob Bonta comes on the heels of the resignation of Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang.

item.title: Commerce approved sales of more than 879,000 AI chips to Chinese companies, Rep. Mast says
item.description: Members of Congress have pushed in the wake of the Jensen Huang scandal for legislation to tighten export controls on chip sales to China.

item.title: Japan core inflation soars to highest this year as energy subsidy expiry pushes up consumer prices
item.description: The core inflation figure — which strips out prices of food — was lower than the 2.3% expected by Reuters-polled economists.

item.title: Anthropic was supposed to save the AI trade. What went wrong?
item.description: Technology stocks tanked despite one of the most hotly anticipated tech IPOs in years. Why Anthropic couldn't revive AI animal spirits.

item.title: Congress passes bill to protect older investors from financial fraud
item.description: Both chambers of Congress have now approved the Financial Exploitation Prevention Act of 2025, which is aimed at protecting vulnerable investors from fraud.

item.title: Trump bought Nvidia, Palantir, SpaceX in September as federal deals, White House ties grew
item.description: President Trump disclosed purchases of Nvidia stock, SpaceX debt and Tesla shares in September, alongside millions of dollars in other investments.

item.title: Jensen Huang's — and Nvidia's — legal exposure balloons
item.description: "It's not going to get any better for Jensen Huang; it's going to get far worse," said Salvatore Graziano, a New York securities litigation attorney.

item.title: Amazon app warns New York of higher costs if Mamdani delivery law passes
item.description: Amazon has lobbied heavily against the proposed legislation, while New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani backed the bill earlier this year.

item.title: Intuit to sell Mailchimp to Bending Spoons for $3.68 billion
item.description: Intuit is offloading a segment that has slowed down revenue growth, for less than a third of what it paid to acquire Mailchimp in 2021.

item.title: Walmart hikes outlook as CEO tells CNBC retailer aims to keep prices low despite soaring fuel costs
item.description: Walmart said it saw strength with store-fulfilled pickup and delivery in its fiscal third quarter.

item.title: Palo Alto stock jumps on earnings beat and company's big bet on securing open-weight models
item.description: Palo Alto Networks reported better-than-expected first-quarter results and inked a $4.5 billion deal for AI startup Applied Compute

item.title: Anthropic IPO: Investors who flip the stock may face brokerage penalty
item.description: Brokerage firms may put future IPO limits in place for investors who sell their Anthropic stake too soon.

item.title: Don’t buy Anthropic right away. Wait for a discount
item.description: Anthropic investor Steve Grasso on why he bought into the Claude creator's blockbuster IPO, and the risks that could weigh on the stock.

item.title: Stocks making the biggest moves Thursday: Intuit, Gap, Anthropic, Ross Stores & more
item.description: Follow along as CNBC covers the biggest stock market moves of the day.

item.title: Amid recent banking outages, should you start carrying cash again? Top advisors weigh in
item.description: Recent outages are prompting a rethink of cash. At the very least, your money should be diversified, top advisors say.

item.title: Kraken parent's acquisition of Tribe Capital flags new chapter in evolution of crypto exchanges
item.description: Payward, the owner of crypto exchange Kraken, is pushing into private markets with its purchase of venture capital and asset management provider Tribe Capital.

item.title: 3-step method to influence people and win them over, from a Stanford expert: ‘Your voice is like a muscle’
item.description: Stanford University communications lecturer Matt Abrahams teaches current and future leaders how to train their voices to be more engaging and persuasive.

item.title: As Sanofi's Pompe drug shortage drags on, some patients struggle to access treatments
item.description: An ongoing shortage of Sanofi’s Pompe disease treatment is forcing some patients to miss critical doses. They worry their health is at risk.

item.title: S&P 500 heads for 6th straight decline. Plus, J&J advances two key products
item.description: Every weekday, the Investing Club releases the Homestretch; an actionable afternoon update just in time for the last hour of trading.

item.title: Booking a Hilton stay? Stack a 20% discount, 5,000 bonus points and up to 200,000 points in card bonus offers
item.description: New Amex Hilton card members may have instant access to their card number, which makes it easier to take advantage of these promotions.

item.title: Netflix, Amazon, Fox to bid for 2030 men's World Cup rights; Disney out
item.description: Netflix, Amazon and Fox are among those bidding on the 2030 men's World Cup media rights. Disney has decided not to bid, sources told CNBC.

item.title: What Ron Johnson's 'Ponzi scheme' label gets wrong about Social Security, experts say
item.description: Social Security's trust funds face a looming shortfall. But AARP says Sen. Ron Johnson's description of the program as a "legal Ponzi scheme" is inaccurate.

item.title: Gold's bad year is getting worse. Why its price keeps falling
item.description: Gold has fallen sharply from its January record as higher interest rates and a stronger dollar change the investment case for the precious metal.

item.title: Trump, Xi, Putin said they plan to boost oil production, revamp UN after trilateral talks
item.description: The leaders of the U.S., China and Russia met in Shenzhen, China on Thursday for a rare trilateral gathering.

item.title: Denmark ratifies Trump security deal over Greenland after months of diplomatic tensions
item.description: It follows months of tensions after President Donald Trump repeatedly said the U.S. should take control of Greenland for national security reasons.

item.title: Anthropic IPO, AI wealth spawn a new, leaner kind of family office
item.description: The Anthropic IPO and a flood of AI wealth are spurring the creation of new family offices built for the era of artificial intelligence.

item.title: Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella calls Outlook outage a 'perfect storm.' Here's what went wrong
item.description: Microsoft shares have dropped nearly 9% since closing at a record high on Nov. 4.

item.title: Intel signs first external customer for advanced 18A chips
item.description: Intel CEO Lip-Bu Tan said Wednesday that the company signed its first outside customer for its 18A chips.
